label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Jehová peleará a ustedes, y ustedes callarán.
spanish: Jehová peleará a ustedes, y ustedes callarán.
readerNote: hold: clause role — לָכֶם is a ל preposition on a niphal verb that licenses Jehová fighting for/to the addressees, not against them, so whether ustedes is beneficiary or opponent is a clause-role call left for the human reader.
